title: RunIdentity
description: Workspace/repo/revision/dirty-digest binding for a Legion run. Grounded in IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md §7.1 'Source identity' (workspace, repository, revision, dirty digest, release candidate, Cortex generation, policy, timestamp) and aligned in field intent with the existing nemesis schemas/core/binding-v1.schema.json (repository, revision, dirtyOverlayDigest, registryDigests) without importing or modifying it.

runId.description: Kernel-issued opaque run handle. See ids.md.

workspace.description: Workspace identity/root the run executed against.

repository.description: Repository identity (name or path), matching nemesis binding-v1's 'repository' field intent.

dirtyDigest.description: Digest of the uncommitted-overlay state, or null when the tree was clean. Equivalent in intent to nemesis binding-v1's 'dirtyOverlayDigest'.

releaseCandidate.description: Release-candidate label bound to this run, when applicable (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §7.1).

cortexGeneration.description: Cortex generation identifier the run's context bound to (IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN §7.1, Workstream F).

policyDigest.description: Digest of the effective policy bundle at capture time.

registryDigests.description: Operation-registry / schema-bundle digests bound at capture time (aligned with nemesis binding-v1's 'registryDigests').
